integrity: The theorem is proved by Gaussian Hilbert-Schmidt kernel identity, gamma midpoint ratio expansion, uniform tail estimates, angular Fourier orthogonality and Fatou/dominated convergence. Independent verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Analytic one-complex-dimensional Gaussian Fock space and growing concentric disks; angular symbol L2(T), exact extended-real limit; no higher dimensions or arbitrary domains. Numeric checks are supplementary and not independent proof. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: A logarithmic angular-Sobolev law for Hilbert–Schmidt Fock localization
